author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell talks with podcaster Ryan Miller about the chaos that hit his family after he had the former head of the Church of Satan on his show, sleepless nights, sudden illness, and snakes appearing on his walks. Ryan discovers his podcast was being cursed on satanic message boards across South Africa and America, and learns to fight what he calls a spiritual fog for two straight months. The attack breaks within five minutes of posting a single prayer request online. A raw look at spiritual warfare from someone who never expected to be in one.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell breaks down a chilling warning about where digital ID and vaccine passports could be heading, a system with the power to look at individuals separately and demand they take a shot on command or face consequences through social credit scoring. He explains how someone flagged as too rebellious could be quietly dosed into compliance, while someone else gets pushed toward whatever role the system decides they should play. Russell argues the culture war is a distraction from the real fight, decentralizing power before any single system gains this much control over our lives. A sharp warning about vaccine passports, digital ID, and where unchecked power could take us next.
